question: What are the different hangar locations and how many pilots correspond to each. Also, what are their average ages?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "pilots" AS SELECT "pilot" AS "pilot", "age" AS "age", "plane" AS "plane" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "plane_hangars" AS SELECT "plane_name" AS "plane_name", "b_1_bomber" AS "b_1_bomber", "b_52_bomber" AS "b_52_bomber", "f_14_fighter" AS "f_14_fighter", "piper_cub" AS "piper_cub" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE materializer_assumption_check AS
WITH pp AS (
  SELECT 'pilots' AS table_name, col, expected_type, actual_type, status FROM tmp_cmp_pilots
), hh AS (
  SELECT 'plane_hangars' AS table_name, col, expected_type, actual_type, status FROM tmp_cmp_hangars
)
SELECT * FROM pp
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM hh
ORDER BY table_name, CASE status WHEN 'missing_in_actual' THEN 0 WHEN 'unexpected_extra' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, col

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE materializer_assumption_check AS
WITH p_info AS (
  SELECT name AS col FROM PRAGMA_table_info('pilots')
), h_info AS (
  SELECT name AS col FROM PRAGMA_table_info('plane_hangars')
), expected_p AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('pilot','age','plane')) AS t(col)
), expected_h AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('plane_name','b_1_bomber','b_52_bomber','f_14_fighter','piper_cub')) AS t(col)
), p_comp AS (
  SELECT 'pilots' AS table_name, e.col, CASE WHEN a.col IS NOT NULL THEN 'present' ELSE 'missing' END AS status
  FROM expected_p e LEFT JOIN p_info a USING(col)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'pilots' AS table_name, a.col, 'unexpected_extra' AS status
  FROM p_info a LEFT JOIN expected_p e USING(col) WHERE e.col IS NULL
), h_comp AS (
  SELECT 'plane_hangars' AS table_name, e.col, CASE WHEN a.col IS NOT NULL THEN 'present' ELSE 'missing' END AS status
  FROM expected_h e LEFT JOIN h_info a USING(col)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'plane_hangars' AS table_name, a.col, 'unexpected_extra' AS status
  FROM h_info a LEFT JOIN expected_h e USING(col) WHERE e.col IS NULL
)
SELECT * FROM p_comp
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM h_comp
ORDER BY table_name, CASE status WHEN 'missing' THEN 0 WHEN 'unexpected_extra' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, col

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH plane_map AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        VALUES
            ('B-1 Bomber','b_1_bomber'),
            ('B-52 Bomber','b_52_bomber'),
            ('F-14 Fighter','f_14_fighter'),
            ('Piper Cub','piper_cub')
    ) AS t(std_plane_name, col_name)
),
long_hangars AS (
    -- Pivot plane_hangars wide->long using UNION ALL
    SELECT 'B-1 Bomber' AS std_plane_name, b_1_bomber AS hangar_location FROM plane_hangars
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'B-52 Bomber', b_52_bomber FROM plane_hangars
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F-14 Fighter', f_14_fighter FROM plane_hangars
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Piper Cub', piper_cub FROM plane_hangars
),
normalized_pilots AS (
    SELECT pilot, age,
           CASE
             WHEN lower(plane) IN ('b-1 bomber','b1 bomber','b 1 bomber') THEN 'B-1 Bomber'
             WHEN lower(plane) IN ('b-52 bomber','b52 bomber','b 52 bomber') THEN 'B-52 Bomber'
             WHEN lower(plane) IN ('f-14 fighter','f14 fighter','f 14 fighter','f-14') THEN 'F-14 Fighter'
             WHEN lower(plane) IN ('piper cub','piper') THEN 'Piper Cub'
             ELSE NULL
           END AS std_plane_name
    FROM pilots
),
joined AS (
    SELECT n.pilot, n.age, l.hangar_location
    FROM normalized_pilots n
    LEFT JOIN long_hangars l USING (std_plane_name)
)
SELECT hangar_location AS hangar,
       COUNT(*) AS pilot_count,
       AVG(age) AS avg_age
FROM joined
WHERE hangar_location IS NOT NULL AND age IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY hangar_location
ORDER BY hangar_location
